scenes.text: Kya viral challenge se study focus badh sakti hai?
scenes.text_en: Can a viral challenge actually help you study much better?

scenes.text: Hostel mein scroll karte waqt lagta hai time waste hua.
scenes.text_en: Scrolling in your hostel room often feels like wasted time.

scenes.text: Lekin ek simple trick study game badal sakti hai.
scenes.text_en: But this simple brain trick can change your daily routine.

scenes.text: Research kehti hai habit-stacking daily habits ko automatic banati hai.
scenes.text_en: Research suggests habit-stacking can make new routines feel automatic.

scenes.text: Ye hack us batchmate ko bhejo jo break mein phasa rehta hai.
scenes.text_en: Send this to that batchmate who always gets stuck on breaks.

scenes.text: Aur brief physical activity attention aur working memory improve karti hai.
scenes.text_en: Also, brief physical activity can enhance attention and working memory.

scenes.text: Toh apne favorite challenge move ko study desk se jodo.
scenes.text_en: Pair your favorite challenge move directly with your study desk.

scenes.text: Har round se pehle bas 10-second ka focus-pause lo.
scenes.text_en: Before every single repetition, take a ten-second focus pause.

scenes.text: Inhale 4 seconds, hold 2 seconds, fir exhale 4 seconds.
scenes.text_en: Inhale four seconds, hold two seconds, and exhale four seconds.

scenes.text: Isse study session shuru karte waqt mind refresh rehta hai.
scenes.text_en: This helps keep your mind steady before starting difficult chapters.

scenes.text: Ab viral challenge scroll mat karo, focus ke liye use karo.
scenes.text_en: Next time, use viral challenges to sharpen your study focus.
